title: Pre-derived adjunction from essentially constant derived systems
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ and $G:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$ be functors with $F$ right adjoint to $G$, and let $K$ be a complex of $\mathcal A$ and $M$ a complex of $\mathcal B$. Define $RF$ at $K$ when the ind-system of objects $F(K')$ in $D(\mathcal B)$, indexed by quasi-isomorphisms $K\to K'$ in $K(\mathcal A)$, is essentially constant with value $RF(K)$; define $LG$ at $M$ dually when the pro-system of objects $G(M')$ in $D(\mathcal A)$, indexed by quasi-isomorphisms $M'\to M$ in $K(\mathcal B)$, is essentially constant with value $LG(M)$. If $RF$ is defined at $K$ and $LG$ is defined at $M$, there is a canonical isomorphism $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal B)}(M,RF(K))\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(LG(M),K)$, functorial in $K$ and $M$ on the triangulated subcategories where the respective derived functors are defined.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma 0DVC (lemma-pre-derived-adjoint-functors, line 9569), the abelian-category case of the general Lemma 0FND (lemma-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general, line 9516), whose proof it inherits

proof.text: Since $RF$ is defined at $K$, the ind-system $I\mapsto F(I)$ indexed by arrows $s:K\to I$ is essentially constant with value $RF(K)$. Applying the essential-constant ind Hom-colimit formula gives $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal B)}(M,RF(K))\cong\varinjlim_{s:K\to I}\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal B)}(M,F(I))$.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma 0FND proof (line 9515), first equality

proof.text: For each $I$, morphisms in the right localization are computed, since the quasi-isomorphisms of the homotopy category form a multiplicative system, by the colimit over arrows $t:P\to M$: $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal B)}(M,F(I))\cong\varinjlim_{t:P\to M}\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal B)}(P,F(I))$.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma 0FND proof (line 9515), second equality

proof.text: The two indexing categories are independent, so the iterated colimits can be interchanged canonically, yielding $\varinjlim_s\varinjlim_t\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal B)}(P,F(I))\cong\varinjlim_t\varinjlim_s\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal B)}(P,F(I))$.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma 0FND proof (line 9515), third equality

proof.text: The underived adjunction $G\dashv F$ gives a natural bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal B)}(P,F(I))\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}(G(P),I)$ for every $P$ and $I$; applying it inside both colimits gives the corresponding iterated-colimit isomorphism.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma 0FND proof (line 9515), fourth equality

proof.text: For each $P$, morphisms in the left localization are computed, since the quasi-isomorphisms of the homotopy category form a multiplicative system, by the colimit over arrows $s:K\to I$: $\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(G(P),K)\cong\varinjlim_{s:K\to I}\operatorname{Hom}_{K(\mathcal A)}(G(P),I)$.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma 0FND proof (line 9515), fifth equality

proof.text: Since $LG$ is defined at $M$, the pro-system $P\mapsto G(P)$ indexed by arrows $t:P\to M$ is essentially constant with value $LG(M)$. Applying the essential-constant pro Hom-colimit formula gives $\varinjlim_{t:P\to M}\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(G(P),K)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(LG(M),K)$.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma 0FND proof (line 9515), sixth equality
